item.title: Capitalism makes cops of us all: The dynamics of Green Line T fares | The Dissenting Opinion
item.description: In a state that spent over $20 billion on highway expansions, the MBTA’s obsession with a two-dollar fare is a choice, not a necessity. If the MBTA were to be at risk of financial ruin because broke college students aren’t paying their dues, that would be a policy failure from Beacon Hill, not a moral failure from students barely getting by.

item.title: ‘Do something’: COM students demand DiChristina address correspondence with Epstein
item.description: Students at Boston University College of Communication voiced sharp criticism after learning COM Dean Mariette DiChristina was in correspondence with Jeffrey Epstein in 2014 and 2015, with many calling for transparency and accountability.

item.title: REVIEW: Spending an evening with Fran Lebowitz
item.description: Over her past few decades of perpetual writer’s block, Fran Lebowitz has made the transition from famous writer to something of a public persona. If her Feb. 19 engagement at Emerson Colonial Theater proves anything, it’s that though she no longer writes, she absolutely still has personality.

item.title: Tell me what you used to be
item.description: “Used to” comes up in conversations, the way people bring up their long-lost teddy bear or the name of their kindergarten best friend — casually and like it doesn’t mean much. I think I say “used to” as a way to balance out the version of me that shows up now. I’m calmer, more direct and sometimes a little bossy but not always exciting. I say “I used to” like I’m trying to reassure people that I’m not boring, I swear — I used to be fun.

item.title: BU cancelled classes three times this semester due to weather conditions. Students, faculty weigh academic, safety concerns.
item.description: Boston University canceled classes and closed campus Monday and Tuesday due to a historic blizzard that swept through the Northeast — the second major snowstorm of the semester that happened to fall on a Monday.
